entries.title: Deuteronomy 10:4
segments: The ten commandments express the will of God and the duty of men, and the effect of divine grace is to lead men heartily to love them and strive in all things perfectly to obey them.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 10:6
segments:
From Beeroth--Mosera; the Israelites twice marched northward along "the plain" of the Arabah to Kadesh, and thence southward from Kadesh towards the Red sea: 
 
first, in the second year of the exodus,

. 
 
secondly, in the beginning of the fortieth year of the exodus,

. 
 
It is probable that the record of encampments in

, belongs to their journey in the second year; and that in the present passage, to their southern journey in the beginning of the fortieth year.  It is to be noticed that when the same route is twice gone over, the sacred writer, as a general rule, names only the more prominent stations.  Mosera, or Moseroth, being in the vicinity of mount Hor, probably at its foot, Aaron may well be said to have died there.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 10:8
segments: At that time; while they were at Sinai.

It is the will of God that there should be an order of men set apart to minister for him, conduct his worship, proclaim his will, and set before men the motives which he has revealed to induce them to do it.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 10:13
segments: The fear and love of God which lead men cheerfully and heartily to obey him, promote not only his glory, but their highest good.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 10:16
segments: Circumcise--the foreskin of your heart; break off your sins, and engage heartily in doing the will of God.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 10:17
segments:
Regardeth not persons; does not regard men according to outward distinctions, or appearance merely, but according to their true character. 
 
vv 17-19 God is no respecter of persons.  He looks with tender compassion on the stranger, the widow, and the fatherless.  He delights to help them, and requires that all, in this, should imitate his example.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 10:18
segments: The judgment of the fatherless; God decides and acts rightly, kindly, and graciously concerning them.  He opens his hand and supplies their wants.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 10:21
segments: He is thy praise; the Giver of their mercies, whom they ought to praise.
